title: Account deletion with a grace period

requirements.text: A signed-in user (re-authenticated) can request deletion of their account
Deletion is scheduled after a configurable grace period, during which the account is disabled
The user can cancel during the grace period and regain access
Existing sessions and tokens are revoked when deletion is requested
Dependent data is deleted, anonymized or retained per a declared policy when the period ends
Only the account owner (or an authorized admin) can request or cancel deletion
The scheduled deletion runs once, survives retries and records completion

notes: No Genlib package covers this workflow. Building blocks elsewhere: password-reset revokes sessions through an injected hook; durable-jobs can run the scheduled deletion.
